scientific_limitations: Classification assumes a commutative Artinian unital ring; it makes no claim for positive-dimensional rings.
The local Gorenstein socle criterion and the dual-ring case of the spectrum are prior theorems.
Equivalent formulations in unindexed lattice and ideal theory literature remain possible.
title: Coprime spectra of Artinian rings detect Gorenstein local components
